sources.title: Poonnatree Jiaviriyaboonya, The influences of Thai divination on Cambodian fortune-telling practice
sources.quality_notes: DOI 10.1017/S0392192123000093; direct lines565–590 describe Thai-mediated zodiac compatibility and local adaptation. Reported 1971 Khmer translation from interview is not original imprint. Not direct proof of complete four-pillar or fourteen-star systems; no historical text collation.

sources.title: 丘文《缅甸民间习俗（二）人之初八字帖》
sources.quality_notes: Direct lines72–97 describe Burmese birth record and palm-leaf horoscope with wheel and body-description fields. Chinese 八字帖 wording alone does not establish four stem-branch pairs or day-master method. Original Burmese term and ancient narrative dates unverified. Not positive Ziwei/Bazi regional attestation.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Named modern Bazi advertisements are not independently confirmed historical lineages.
IFSA Feng Shui membership does not establish a separate Bazi school.
Thai-mediated animal zodiac practice does not establish full Ziwei or Ziping.
Burmese Chinese translated 八字帖 label does not establish method identity.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Cambodian first dated actual use and independently corroborated method records; Myanmar and Laos named local witnesses; three regions' Ziwei history; 1900 Shan calendar native original pages.
